messages.content: I’m committing a book that discharges the initial charge before dawn, recharges during low-price solar hours, and holds reserves through the evening peak. The feasibility check projects about **$54,995** in total profit; actual results will depend on real-time prices and reserve deployments.

ERCOT has deployed ECRS and Non-Spin. We have no awards in those products during the deployment window, so these calls do not draw down our battery. I’m keeping it fully charged to back the fixed RRS awards.
